scientific_integrity: Exact finite-field enumeration and proof via Weil reciprocity; geometric automorphism classification is independently checked against the originating lemma and standard Artin–Schreier descent.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns one explicit prime-field model, its zeta function, slopes, automorphisms and minimal genus in characteristic 3. It does not assert superspeciality, all characteristics, or a classification of every minimal-genus model.
title: A supersingular genus-four Artin–Schreier curve with minimal geometric automorphism group
